description: State machine and conversational prompt graph for automated AI voice screening calls.

stages.description: Greet candidate by name, confirm identity, state purpose of the call, and request 5-7 minutes of time.
stages.bot_prompt: Hello {candidate_name}! This is {bot_name} calling on behalf of the talent acquisition team regarding your application for the {role_name} position. Is this a convenient time for a quick 5-minute pre-screening conversation?
stages.fallback_prompt: No problem at all. When would be a better time today for us to connect?

stages.description: Invite candidate to briefly introduce themselves.
stages.transition_prompt: Great! Let's begin. Could you tell me a little about yourself and your recent engineering journey?
Thank you. Moving quickly to your educational background...

stages.description: Assess total work duration and core role responsibilities.
stages.transition_prompt: Understood. Let's discuss your hands-on work experience.

stages.description: Evaluate core technical depth and role competencies.
stages.transition_prompt: That gives great context. Now I'd love to ask a couple of technical questions specifically focused on the {role_name} role.

stages.description: Confirm current location and relocation or remote availability.
stages.transition_prompt: Thanks for sharing those technical details. Regarding work location and flexibility...

stages.description: Capture current and expected CTC for compensation alignment.
Determine official notice duration and earliest available start date.
stages.transition_prompt: Lastly, regarding your availability to join...

stages.description: Thank the candidate, explain next steps, and conclude the automated call.
stages.bot_prompt: Thank you so much for your time today, {candidate_name}. I have recorded all your details. Our hiring team will review your responses alongside your technical profile, and our recruiter will follow up with you within 24 to 48 hours. Have a wonderful day ahead!

conversational_fallbacks.audio_unclear: I'm sorry, I could not hear that clearly. Could you please repeat your last sentence?
conversational_fallbacks.out_of_domain_query: I am an automated AI screening assistant focused on your background and profile. Our talent team will be happy to answer detailed questions during your next interview round.
conversational_fallbacks.candidate_hesitation: Take your time! Whenever you're ready, please go ahead.
